Dear Gerard Antwerp team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content & Marketing Intern position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and web management, I'm excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to your store in Steenhouwersvest.

In my current role at Episto, I create and edit content for client websites, manage WordPress sites, and run SEO campaigns. I'm comfortable shooting and editing photos and videos for social media, and I've built and maintained my own project, mirook.com, where I handle everything from content to technical SEO. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, and my Dutch is at B1 level and improving.

I'm eager to apply my skills to your Instagram content, webshop management, and marketing calendar. I'm a quick learner, reliable, and passionate about creating engaging content that drives results.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Gerard Antwerp. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Gerard Antwerp team,

I'm excited to apply for the Content & Marketing Intern position at Gerard Antwerp. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, SEO, and web management, I'm drawn to the hands-on, in-store nature of this role and the opportunity to contribute to your brand's online presence.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I've honed skills directly relevant to this position. I write keyword-targeted blog content, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using analytics tools. I'm comfortable shooting and editing content for social media, having created and integrated social media content for my own project, mirook.com. There, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and ran technical SEO audits—all skills that translate well to managing a webshop and creating engaging Instagram content.

I'm fluent in English and Turkish, and my Dutch is at B1 level and improving. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just next to Antwerp, so commuting to the store is easy. I'm eager to learn the ropes of e-commerce content management and campaign support, and I'm confident I can quickly become a valuable asset to your team.

I'm particularly excited about the opportunity to help run the marketing calendar around drops and events, as I enjoy the strategic side of marketing. I'm a proactive, detail-oriented worker who thrives in fast-paced environments.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Gerard Antwerp.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
